senses.en_definition: To catch or seize something with the hands or a tool; to catch or trap an animal.
To catch something that is thrown or moving quickly.

collocations.en: catch a ball with both hands

senses.en_definition: To arrest or apprehend someone suspected of an offence.
To capture someone and take them prisoner, especially in war.
To receive or pick up a broadcast, sound, or other signal.
To grasp or understand what is said or taught.
To perceive or detect something through the senses or awareness.
Of a hook, snare, or similar device: to work successfully and catch something.

messages.en: I've already caught three here at the end of the jetty. How many have you caught?
You're really good at catching fish. I've been here all this time and haven't caught a single one 😂
Come over here and give my bait a try.
I'm at the tower now. Where are you?
I'm right by the entrance. Stay there, I'm coming over.

senses.en_definition: To dance, moving the body to the rhythm of music.

messages.en: Want to dance together this afternoon? I'm just learning too.
I'd love to! But don't laugh if I get the steps wrong, okay?

senses.en_definition: To pull, drag, or tow something towards oneself or in a particular direction.
To draw or pull something out of its position or container.
To breathe or suck something in.
To attract attention or interest; to appeal to someone.
To retract or take back something previously put forward; in the phrase menarik diri, to withdraw from participation.

messages.en: This film looks interesting. Have you seen it yet?
Not yet. I've only seen the trailer. Looks pretty funny. Fancy watching it tonight?
